en: Minus twenty degrees of freezing cold...

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: A snowstorm all around, a bone-biting wind.

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: In weather like that, do you know what happens if a normal person steps out without clothes?

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: In just five to ten minutes, the blood vessels constrict.

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: After twenty minutes, body temperature drops dangerously and hypothermia sets in.

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: Within half an hour, the heart stops and the body freezes like an ice doll and dies!

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: This is an absolute rule written by medical science!

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: But... on that same minus-twenty-degree Himalayan snow...

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: what if monks sit for hours with nothing on but a thin cotton cloth?

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: And if cloths soaked in ice water are draped over their bodies...

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: what if, instead of freezing, those wet cloths steam and dry from their body heat?

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: Hello everyone, welcome to Be Practical With Kishore!

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: This is not just a story...

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: It's an absolute reality that world-famous Harvard University medical scientists tested themselves in the hills of Ladakh and showed the world!

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: Meanwhile in Europe, a man named Wim Hof...

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: runs through Arctic Circle snow wearing only shorts,

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: sits neck-deep in a box of pure ice cubes for two hours,

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: and even with dangerous bacteria injected into his blood, he neutralises it with his internal heat!

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: How can a fire blaze inside the human body in freezing snow?

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: How can human willpower control body temperature?
